 if OS.get_environment('SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH').is_empty() or DisplayServer.get_name()=='headless':

 print('WORLD METRICS: meshes=', main.world.mesh_count, ' materials=', main.world.material_cache.size(), ' nodes=', Performance.get_monitor(Performance.OBJECT_NODE_COUNT), ' fps=', Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_FPS), ' draw_calls=', RenderingServer.get_rendering_info(RenderingServer.RENDERING_INFO_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME), ' static_memory=', Performance.get_monitor(Performance.MEMORY_STATIC))
 if not await _review_world(): return
 if OS.get_cmdline_user_args().has('--review-world-only'):
  await main._quit_game();return
 for number in range(1,13):
  var id='game-%03d'%number

   if point.id==id: main.world.player.position=point.position+Vector3(0,0.3,0)

  var waypoint=0
  var last_cycle=-1

  var waypoints=[Vector2(520,305),Vector2(780,270),Vector2(880,270),Vector2(960,360),Vector2(820,480),Vector2(1080,320)]

  while main.session!=null and not main.session.ended and Time.get_ticks_msec()<deadline:

     if s.balloon_delivery_index>=1 and waypoint==0: waypoint=1

     var dock_approach=waypoint not in [1,2,3]
     var distance_to_dock=s.p.distance_to(s.target)

     if brake_now!=balloon_brake:
      _held_key(KEY_SPACE,brake_now);balloon_brake=brake_now
    2:
     if not s.ended:
      var state=s.kite_model.snapshot()
      var ring_index=int(state.nextRing)
      if ring_index<5:
       var error=float(state.height)-float(s.kite_model.RING_HEIGHT[ring_index])

func _option(name:String,index:int) -> bool:
 var selector=main.overlay.find_child(name,true,false)
 if selector==null: await _fail('Missing appearance selector '+name);return false
 _motion(selector.get_global_rect().get_center());_click(selector.get_global_rect().get_center())
 await get_tree().process_frame
 var popup=selector.get_popup()
 if popup.visible:
  _popup_key(popup,KEY_ESCAPE)
  await get_tree().process_frame
 _key(KEY_SPACE)
 await get_tree().process_frame
 if not popup.visible: await _fail('Appearance popup did not open '+name);return false
 var step=KEY_DOWN if index>selector.selected else KEY_UP
 for i in range(absi(index-selector.selected)):
  _popup_key(popup,step)
  await get_tree().process_frame
 _popup_key(popup,KEY_ENTER)
 await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
 if selector.selected!=index: await _fail('Appearance popup selected '+str(selector.selected)+' expected '+str(index));return false
 return true
func _popup_key(popup:Window,code:int) -> void:
 if OS.get_name()!='Windows':
  push_error('Native popup keys require Windows PostMessage input')
  return
 var key_name=''
 match code:
  KEY_DOWN: key_name='down'
  KEY_UP: key_name='up'
  KEY_ENTER, KEY_KP_ENTER: key_name='enter'
  KEY_ESCAPE: key_name='escape'
  KEY_SPACE: key_name='space'
  _: push_error('Unsupported native popup key '+str(code));return
 var hwnd=DisplayServer.window_get_native_handle(DisplayServer.WINDOW_HANDLE,popup.get_window_id())
 if hwnd==0:
  push_error('PopupMenu returned no Windows HWND')
  return
 var output=[]
 var script_path=ProjectSettings.globalize_path('res://tools/native_popup_key.py')
 var exit_code=OS.execute('python',[script_path,str(hwnd),key_name],output,true)
 if exit_code!=0:
  push_error('PostMessage popup key failed: '+str(output))

 var control=main.overlay.find_child(name,true,false)
 if control==null: await _fail('Missing named clothing button '+name);return false
 var parent=control.get_parent()
 while parent!=null:

  parent=parent.get_parent()
 await get_tree().create_timer(0.1).timeout
 var rect=control.get_global_rect()
 if not main.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().encloses(rect): await _fail('Clothing button outside viewport '+name);return false
 _motion(rect.get_center());_click(rect.get_center())
 await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
 return true
func _button(needle:String) -> void:
 var button=_find(main.overlay,needle)
 if button:
  var rect=button.get_global_rect()
  if not main.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().encloses(rect):
   push_error('Native button outside viewport '+needle+' '+str(rect));return
  _motion(rect.get_center())
  _click(rect.get_center())
 else: push_error('Missing native review button '+needle)
func _find(node:Node,needle:String) -> Button:
 if node is Button and node.text.contains(needle): return node
 for child in node.get_children():
  var found=_find(child,needle)
  if found:return found
 return null
func _held_key(code:int,pressed:bool) -> void:
 var event=InputEventKey.new();event.keycode=code;event.physical_keycode=code;event.pressed=pressed;Input.parse_input_event(event)
func _key(code:int) -> void:
 for pressed in [true,false]:
  var event=InputEventKey.new();event.keycode=code;event.physical_keycode=code;event.pressed=pressed;Input.parse_input_event(event)
func _motion(position:Vector2) -> void:
 var event=InputEventMouseMotion.new();event.position=position;event.global_position=position;event.window_id=get_window().get_window_id();Input.parse_input_event(event)
func _click(position:Vector2) -> void:
 for pressed in [true,false]:
  var event=InputEventMouseButton.new();event.position=position;event.global_position=position;event.window_id=get_window().get_window_id();event.button_index=MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT;event.button_mask=MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT if pressed else 0;event.pressed=pressed;Input.parse_input_event(event)
func _crowd_priority_lane(model) -> int:
 var chosen=-1
 var earliest_deadline=INF
 for direction in 2:
  var lane_queue:Array=model.queues[direction]
  if lane_queue.is_empty(): continue
  var head:Dictionary=lane_queue[0]
  var deadline=float(head.arrived_at)+float(head.patience)
  if deadline<earliest_deadline:
   earliest_deadline=deadline
   chosen=direction
 return chosen
func _fail(message:String) -> void:
 push_error(message)
 main.audio.shutdown()
 await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
 get_tree().quit(1)

## Dispatch a complete, observable pointer click through the normal input route.
## Both coordinates matter: Input tracks global_position, while Viewport hit-tests
## position. Leaving global_position at zero moves the tracked pointer to (0, 0)
## between events even if gui_get_hovered_control() briefly reports the target.
func _native_click_button(button: BaseButton, context: String) -> bool:
 if not is_instance_valid(button) or not button.is_visible_in_tree() or button.disabled:
  await _fail("Native click target is missing, hidden or disabled: " + context)
  return false
 var ancestor := button.get_parent()
 while ancestor != null:
  if ancestor is ScrollContainer: ancestor.ensure_control_visible(button)
  ancestor = ancestor.get_parent()
 await get_tree().process_frame
 await get_tree().process_frame
 var viewport := button.get_viewport()
 var rect := button.get_global_rect()
 var visible_rect := viewport.get_visible_rect()
 ancestor = button.get_parent()
 while ancestor != null:
  if ancestor is Control and ancestor.clip_contents:
   visible_rect = visible_rect.intersection(ancestor.get_global_rect())
  ancestor = ancestor.get_parent()
 if not visible_rect.encloses(rect):
  await _fail("Native click target is clipped: %s rect=%s visible=%s" % [context, rect, visible_rect])
  return false
 var observation := {"down": 0, "up": 0, "pressed": 0, "gui": []}
 var on_down := func(): observation.down += 1
 var on_up := func(): observation.up += 1
 var on_pressed := func(): observation.pressed += 1
 var on_gui := func(event: InputEvent):
  if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
   observation.gui.append("down" if event.pressed else "up")
 button.button_down.connect(on_down)
 button.button_up.connect(on_up)
 button.pressed.connect(on_pressed)
 button.gui_input.connect(on_gui)
 var target_path := str(button.get_path())
 var point := viewport.get_final_transform() * rect.get_center()
 # Flush queued OS/fixture events before beginning this click. No input state,
 # control signal or gameplay callback is assigned or invoked directly.
 Input.flush_buffered_events()
 var motion := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
 motion.position = point
 motion.global_position = point
 motion.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
 motion.button_mask = Input.get_mouse_button_mask()
 Input.parse_input_event(motion)
 Input.flush_buffered_events()
 var hovered := viewport.gui_get_hovered_control()
 var diagnostics := "target=%s rect=%s pointer=%s hovered=%s button_hovered=%s initial_mask=%d" % [target_path, rect, point, str(hovered.get_path()) if is_instance_valid(hovered) else "none", button.is_hovered(), Input.get_mouse_button_mask()]
 if not button.is_hovered() or not (hovered == button or is_instance_valid(hovered) and button.is_ancestor_of(hovered)):
  for pair in [[button.button_down, on_down], [button.button_up, on_up], [button.pressed, on_pressed], [button.gui_input, on_gui]]:
   pair[0].disconnect(pair[1])
  await _fail("Native pointer did not hover its target: %s; %s" % [context, diagnostics])
  return false
 # Dispatch and flush each distinct event without yielding to unrelated OS
 # motion or deferred focus changes between the observed down and release.
 for is_down in [true, false]:
  var event := InputEventMouseButton.new()
  event.position = point
  event.global_position = point
  event.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
  event.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
  event.button_mask = MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT if is_down else 0
  event.pressed = is_down
  Input.parse_input_event(event)
  Input.flush_buffered_events()
 if is_instance_valid(button):
  for pair in [[button.button_down, on_down], [button.button_up, on_up], [button.pressed, on_pressed], [button.gui_input, on_gui]]:
   pair[0].disconnect(pair[1])
 diagnostics += " observed=%s final_mask=%d" % [observation, Input.get_mouse_button_mask()]
 if observation.down != 1 or observation.pressed != 1:
  await _fail("Native click did not activate its target: %s; %s" % [context, diagnostics])
  return false
 print("INPUT: ", context, " ", diagnostics)
 await get_tree().process_frame
 await get_tree().process_frame
 return true

extends "res://work/tutorial-current-20261020/pipe-accepted-controls/native_pipe_orders_review.gd"

## SG pipe input review through the actual station, Session HUD, and result UI.
const ORDER_ROUTES: Array = [
	[0, 4, 6, 15],
	[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 12],
	[0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 10, 14, 15]
]
const DESIGN_BOARD := Rect2(320.0, 166.0, 640.0, 400.0)

var _case_metrics: Dictionary = {}
var _retry_event_state: Dictionary = {}

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	super._process(delta)

func _run() -> void:
	if not _native_preflight("Pipe controls review"):
		return
	progress.reset_progress()
	progress.intro_seen = true
	progress.settings["assist"] = false
	progress.settings["reduced_motion"] = false
	main = _instantiate_main()
	if main == null:
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return
	get_tree().root.add_child(main)
	await get_tree().create_timer(1.0).timeout
	if not await _require_live_main("initial station load"): return
	if not await _enter_station(): return
	if not await _launch_from_station("開始遊玩"): return
	if not await _require_live_session("formal launch"): return

	# Solve the first work order with real cursor arrows and Space, then exercise
	# the shared pause/resume and confirmed retry while the live flow timer runs.
	if not await _solve_keyboard_order(0): return
	if not await _review_flow_pause_resume_retry(): return
	for order_index in 3:
		if not await _solve_keyboard_order(order_index): return
		if order_index < 2 and not await _wait_for_order(order_index + 1): return
	if not await _wait_for_result(): return
	if not await _assert_result("keyboard-standard", false, false): return
	if not await _require_live_main("formal result collection"): return
	if not progress.photos.has("photo-welcome-game-7") or progress.normal_count() < 1:
		await _fail("Successful keyboard challenge did not follow Main's ordinary collection path")
		return
	var saved_photos: Dictionary = progress.photos.duplicate(true)
	var saved_normal: int = progress.normal_count()
	var saved_devil: int = progress.devil_count()
	var saved_achievements: Dictionary = progress.achievements.duplicate(true)
	print("PIPE CASE: keyboard-standard score=%d turns=%d devil=%s orders=%s schema=%s" % [int(observed_result.get("score", -1)), int(_case_metrics.get("turns", -1)), str(observed_result.get("devil", false)), str(_case_metrics.get("order_turns", [])), str(observed_result.keys())])

	if not await _return_to_station(): return
	progress.settings["assist"] = true
	progress.settings["reduced_motion"] = true
	if not await _enter_station(): return
	if not await _launch_from_station("練習操作"): return
	if not await _require_live_session("practice launch"): return
	if not active.assisted or not active.practice_mode or not active.reduced_motion:
		await _fail("Pipe practice launch did not preserve assisted/reduced-motion settings")
		return
	if not active.minigame_hud._badge.visible or not active.minigame_hud._badge.text.contains("練習"):
		await _fail("Pipe practice HUD omitted the no-collection badge")
		return
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.2).timeout
	if not await _require_live_session("practice ready wait"): return
	for order_index in 3:
		if not await _solve_pointer_order(order_index): return
		if order_index < 2 and not await _wait_for_order(order_index + 1): return
	if not await _wait_for_result(): return
	if not await _assert_result("pointer-assisted-reduced-practice", true, true): return
	if not await _require_live_main("practice collection verification"): return
	if progress.photos != saved_photos or progress.normal_count() != saved_normal or progress.devil_count() != saved_devil or progress.achievements != saved_achievements:
		await _fail("Successful pipe practice changed saved photos, counts, or achievements")
		return
	if not is_instance_valid(main) or main.modal_kind != "result" or not _result_has_text("分數、拍貼、任務與成就都沒有寫入紀錄") or not _result_has_text("練習分數 2620（不保存）"):
		await _fail("Practice result UI did not explain that its outcome is not recorded")
		return
	await _shot("pipe-controls-pointer-practice-result")
	if not await _require_live_main("practice result capture"): return
	print("PIPE CASE: pointer-assisted-reduced-practice score=%d turns=%d devil=%s orders=%s; saved collections unchanged" % [int(observed_result.get("score", -1)), int(_case_metrics.get("turns", -1)), str(observed_result.get("devil", false)), str(_case_metrics.get("order_turns", []))])
	print("PASS: native SG pipe keyboard cursor/Space and pointer-only three-order routes, pause/resume, retry reset, reduced-motion flow payoff, and non-collecting practice")
	await main._quit_game()

func _enter_station() -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_main("_enter_station"): return false
	var found := false
	for point in main.world.points:
		if point.id != "game-007":
			continue
		main.world.player.position = point.position + Vector3(0, 0.3, 0)
		found = true
		break
	if not found:
		await _fail("Pipe station game-007 is missing")
		return false
	var deadline := _wall_deadline(4.0)
	while main.world.nearest.get("id", "") != "game-007" and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await get_tree().physics_frame
		if not await _require_live_main("_enter_station after frame wait"): return false
	if main.world.nearest.get("id", "") != "game-007":
		await _fail("Pipe station did not become the real nearest interaction")
		return false
	_key(KEY_E)
	deadline = _wall_deadline(3.0)
	while main.modal_kind != "game_info" and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_main("_enter_station after frame wait"): return false
	if main.modal_kind != "game_info":
		await _fail("E did not open game-007 station details")
		return false
	return true

func _launch_from_station(action: String) -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_main("_launch_from_station"): return false
	var button := _find(main.overlay, action)
	if button == null and action == "練習操作":
		var options := _find(main.overlay, "玩法與選項")
		if options == null or not await _native_click_button(options, "open pipe rules and practice options"):
			await _fail("Pipe practice options could not be opened from the compact invite")
			return false
		button = _find(main.overlay, action)
	if button == null or not await _native_click_button(button, "game-007 " + action):
		await _fail("Station action did not start game-007: " + action)
		return false
	if not await _require_live_main("station action completion"): return false
	var deadline := _wall_deadline(4.0)
	while is_instance_valid(main) and not is_instance_valid(main.session) and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_main("_launch_from_station after frame wait"): return false
	if not is_instance_valid(main) or not is_instance_valid(main.session):
		await _fail("Station action left no active pipe Session")
		return false
	active = main.session
	observed_result.clear()
	_case_metrics.clear()
	active.finished.connect(_capture_result)
	return true

func _capture_result(result: Dictionary) -> void:
	observed_result = result.duplicate(true)
	if is_instance_valid(active):
		_case_metrics = {
			"score": active.score,
			"turns": active.pipe_model.total_turns,
			"order_turns": active.pipe_model.order_turns.duplicate(),
			"order_pars": active.pipe_model.orders.map(func(order: Dictionary): return int(order.turn_par)),
			"completed_beds": active.pipe_model.completed_beds,
			"elapsed": active.elapsed,
			"assisted": active.assisted,
			"practice": active.practice_mode
		}

func _solve_keyboard_order(order_index: int) -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_session("_solve_keyboard_order"): return false
	var route: Array = ORDER_ROUTES[order_index]
	var expected_turn_start: int = active.pipe_model.total_turns
	for cell_variant in route:
		var cell := int(cell_variant)
		if not await _move_keyboard_cursor_to(cell): return false
		if not await _require_live_session("keyboard cursor completion"): return false
		var turns_before: int = active.pipe_model.total_turns
		var mask_before: int = int(active.pipe_model.cells[cell])
		_key(KEY_SPACE)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
		if active.pipe_cursor != cell or active.pipe_model.cursor != cell:
			await _fail("Keyboard selection did not land on tile %d (session/model=%d/%d)" % [cell, active.pipe_cursor, active.pipe_model.cursor])
			return false
		if active.pipe_model.total_turns != turns_before + 1 or int(active.pipe_model.cells[cell]) != _rotate_mask(mask_before):
			await _fail("Space did not make exactly one real rotation at tile %d" % cell)
			return false
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_session("_solve_keyboard_order after frame wait"): return false
	if not active.pipe_model.connected or active.pipe_model.order_index != order_index:
		await _fail("Keyboard route did not truly connect order %d: %s" % [order_index + 1, str(active.pipe_model.snapshot())])
		return false
	if active.pipe_model.order_turns[order_index] != route.size() or active.pipe_model.total_turns != expected_turn_start + route.size():
		await _fail("Keyboard rotations did not match live model order/total counters")
		return false
	await _shot("pipe-controls-keyboard-flow-%d" % (order_index + 1))
	if not _session_is_live() and (order_index != 2 or observed_result.is_empty() or _case_metrics.is_empty()):
		await _fail("Keyboard pipe Session disappeared before its verified final result")
		return false
	return true

func _move_keyboard_cursor_to(cell: int) -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_session("_move_keyboard_cursor_to"): return false
	var target_column := cell % 4
	var target_row := int(cell / 4)
	while active.pipe_cursor % 4 != target_column:
		_key(KEY_RIGHT if active.pipe_cursor % 4 < target_column else KEY_LEFT)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_session("_move_keyboard_cursor_to after wait"): return false
	while int(active.pipe_cursor / 4) != target_row:
		_key(KEY_DOWN if int(active.pipe_cursor / 4) < target_row else KEY_UP)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_session("_move_keyboard_cursor_to after wait"): return false
	if active.pipe_cursor != cell:
		await _fail("Arrow-key navigation expected cell %d, actual cursor %d" % [cell, active.pipe_cursor])
		return false
	return true

func _review_flow_pause_resume_retry() -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_session("_review_flow_pause_resume_retry"): return false
	if not active.pipe_connected or active.pipe_model.flow_remaining <= 0.0:
		await _fail("First keyboard-connected order did not start its live water-flow timer")
		return false
	var pause := active.minigame_hud.find_child("PauseButton", true, false) as Button
	if not await _native_click_button(pause, "pause connected pipe order"): return false
	if not await _require_live_session("_review_flow_pause_resume_retry after native click"): return false
	if not active.paused:
		await _fail("HUD pause control did not pause the connected pipe round")
		return false
	var frozen_elapsed: float = active.elapsed
	var frozen_phase: float = active.phase
	var frozen_flow: float = active.pipe_model.flow_remaining
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.35).timeout
	if not await _require_live_session("_review_flow_pause_resume_retry after wait"): return false
	if not is_equal_approx(active.elapsed, frozen_elapsed) or not is_equal_approx(active.phase, frozen_phase) or not is_equal_approx(active.pipe_model.flow_remaining, frozen_flow):
		await _fail("Paused pipe changed elapsed, phase, or water-flow timer")
		return false
	var resume := active.minigame_hud.find_child("ResumeButton", true, false) as Button
	if not await _native_click_button(resume, "resume connected pipe order"): return false
	if not await _require_live_session("_review_flow_pause_resume_retry after native click"): return false
	if active.paused:
		await _fail("HUD resume control left pipe Session paused")
		return false
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.2).timeout
	if not await _require_live_session("_review_flow_pause_resume_retry after wait"): return false
	if active.pipe_model.flow_remaining >= frozen_flow or active.elapsed <= frozen_elapsed:
		await _fail("Resuming pipe did not continue the original live order/timer")
		return false
	if not await _native_click_button(pause, "pause before pipe retry"): return false
	if not await _require_live_session("_review_flow_pause_resume_retry after native click"): return false
	var retry := active.minigame_hud.find_child("RetryButton", true, false) as Button
	if not await _native_click_button(retry, "request pipe retry"): return false
	if not await _require_live_session("_review_flow_pause_resume_retry after native click"): return false
	var confirm := active.minigame_hud.find_child("ConfirmAction", true, false) as Button
	_retry_event_state.clear()
	confirm.pressed.connect(_capture_retry_event_state)
	if not await _native_click_button(confirm, "confirm pipe retry"): return false
	if not await _require_live_session("_review_flow_pause_resume_retry after native click"): return false
	if _retry_event_state.is_empty() or bool(_retry_event_state.get("paused", true)) or bool(_retry_event_state.get("ended", true)) or float(_retry_event_state.get("elapsed", -1.0)) != 0.0 or int(_retry_event_state.get("score", -1)) != 0 or int(_retry_event_state.get("order", -1)) != 0 or int(_retry_event_state.get("turns", -1)) != 0 or int(_retry_event_state.get("beds", -1)) != 0 or float(_retry_event_state.get("flow", -1.0)) != 0.0 or bool(_retry_event_state.get("connected", true)) or int(_retry_event_state.get("cursor", -1)) != 0:
		await _fail("ConfirmAction signal did not observe the exact instant reset: " + str(_retry_event_state))
		return false
	if main.session != active or active.paused or active.ended or active.elapsed < 0.0 or active.elapsed > 0.20 or active.pipe_model.order_index != 0 or active.pipe_model.total_turns != 0 or active.pipe_cursor != 0:
		await _fail("Pipe retry changed the live Session or advanced beyond a normal click's post-reset frames")
		return false
	print("PIPE RETRY RESET: " + str(_retry_event_state) + " post_click_elapsed=%.4f" % active.elapsed)
	await _shot("pipe-controls-retry-reset")
	if not await _require_live_session("_review_flow_pause_resume_retry after wait"): return false
	return true

func _capture_retry_event_state() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(active):
		return
	_retry_event_state = {
		"instance_id": active.get_instance_id(),
		"paused": active.paused,
		"ended": active.ended,
		"elapsed": active.elapsed,
		"score": active.score,
		"order": active.pipe_model.order_index,
		"turns": active.pipe_model.total_turns,
		"beds": active.pipe_model.completed_beds,
		"flow": active.pipe_model.flow_remaining,
		"connected": active.pipe_model.connected,
		"cursor": active.pipe_cursor
	}

func _solve_pointer_order(order_index: int) -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_session("_solve_pointer_order"): return false
	var route: Array = ORDER_ROUTES[order_index]
	var turns_before_order: int = active.pipe_model.total_turns
	for cell_variant in route:
		var cell := int(cell_variant)
		var turns_before: int = active.pipe_model.total_turns
		var screen_point: Vector2 = active.presentation.get_global_transform_with_canvas() * _design_cell_center(cell)
		_click(screen_point)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
		if active.pipe_cursor != cell or active.pipe_model.cursor != cell:
			await _fail("Pointer click targeted cell %d but live cursor/model is %d/%d" % [cell, active.pipe_cursor, active.pipe_model.cursor])
			return false
		if active.pipe_model.total_turns != turns_before + 1:
			await _fail("Pointer click did not rotate exactly one live tile at cell %d" % cell)
			return false
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_session("_solve_pointer_order after frame wait"): return false
	if not active.pipe_model.connected or active.pipe_model.order_index != order_index:
		await _fail("Pointer route did not truly connect order %d" % (order_index + 1))
		return false
	if active.pipe_model.order_turns[order_index] != route.size() or active.pipe_model.total_turns != turns_before_order + route.size():
		await _fail("Pointer rotations did not match live model order/total counters")
		return false
	if not active.presentation.reduced_motion or not active.presentation.bloom_visible() or not is_equal_approx(active.presentation.flow_progress, 1.0):
		await _fail("Reduced-motion successful order hid its static completed-water/flower feedback")
		return false
	await _shot("pipe-controls-pointer-reduced-flow-%d" % (order_index + 1))
	if not _session_is_live() and (order_index != 2 or observed_result.is_empty() or _case_metrics.is_empty()):
		await _fail("Pointer pipe Session disappeared before its verified final result")
		return false
	return true

func _design_cell_center(cell: int) -> Vector2:
	var column := cell % 4
	var row := int(cell / 4)
	return DESIGN_BOARD.position + Vector2((float(column) + 0.5) * DESIGN_BOARD.size.x / 4.0, (float(row) + 0.5) * DESIGN_BOARD.size.y / 4.0)

func _rotate_mask(mask: int) -> int:
	return ((mask << 1) & 15) | (mask >> 3)

func _wait_for_order(expected: int) -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_session("_wait_for_order"): return false
	var deadline := _wall_deadline(3.0)
	while _session_is_live() and active.pipe_model.order_index < expected and not active.ended and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_session("_wait_for_order after frame wait"): return false
	if not await _require_live_session("order wait completion"): return false
	if active.ended or active.pipe_model.order_index != expected or active.pipe_model.completed_beds != expected:
		await _fail("Connected order did not complete into the next work order (%d): %s" % [expected, str(active.pipe_model.snapshot())])
		return false
	if not observed_result.is_empty():
		await _fail("Pipe completed before its final third order")
		return false
	return true

func _wait_for_result() -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_main("_wait_for_result"): return false
	if not await _require_live_main("station action completion"): return false
	var deadline := _wall_deadline(4.0)
	while is_instance_valid(main) and main.modal_kind != "result" and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_main("_wait_for_result after frame wait"): return false
	if not is_instance_valid(main) or main.modal_kind != "result" or observed_result.is_empty():
		await _fail("game-007 did not produce the real Main result and Session signal")
		return false
	return true

func _assert_result(label: String, expect_assisted: bool, expect_practice: bool) -> bool:
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if str(observed_result.get("game_id", "")) != "game-007" or not bool(observed_result.get("success", false)):
		await _fail(label + " did not complete the actual game-007 objective: " + str(observed_result))
		return false
	if int(_case_metrics.get("completed_beds", -1)) != 3 or int(_case_metrics.get("turns", -1)) != 19 or _case_metrics.get("order_turns", []) != [4, 7, 8]:
		await _fail(label + " did not record the three actual orders and 19 real rotations: " + str(_case_metrics))
		return false
	if int(observed_result.get("score", -1)) != int(_case_metrics.get("score", -2)) or int(observed_result.get("score", -1)) != 2620:
		await _fail(label + " score/result does not match its three work orders: " + str(_case_metrics))
		return false
	if bool(observed_result.get("assisted", false)) != expect_assisted or bool(observed_result.get("practice", false)) != expect_practice:
		await _fail(label + " result flags do not match the live Session")
		return false
	var within_all_pars := true
	var actual_turns: Array = _case_metrics.get("order_turns", [])
	var actual_pars: Array = _case_metrics.get("order_pars", [])
	if actual_pars.size() != 3:
		await _fail(label + " omitted the actual work-order pars")
		return false
	for index in 3:
		within_all_pars = within_all_pars and int(actual_turns[index]) <= int(actual_pars[index])
	if bool(observed_result.get("devil", false)) != within_all_pars:
		await _fail(label + " devil outcome did not reflect the actual per-order pars: " + str(observed_result))
		return false
	if not observed_result.has("mistakes") or not (observed_result.get("score_summary", {}) is Dictionary) or not (observed_result.score_summary.get("rows", []) is Array):
		await _fail(label + " result omitted the established mistakes/score-summary schema")
		return false
	if not _result_has_text("19 次") or not _result_has_text("工單 1") or not _result_has_text("目標 4 次"):
		await _fail(label + " result did not display real turn counts and per-order precision targets")
		return false
	return true

func _return_to_station() -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_main("_return_to_station"): return false
	var button := _find(main.overlay, "返回遊園")
	if button == null or not await _native_click_button(button, "return to the harbor park"):
		return false
	if not await _require_live_main("station action completion"): return false
	var deadline := _wall_deadline(4.0)
	while is_instance_valid(main) and main.modal_kind != "" and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_main("_return_to_station after frame wait"): return false
	return is_instance_valid(main) and main.modal_kind == ""

func _result_has_text(fragment: String) -> bool:
	return _contains_label(main.overlay, fragment)

func _contains_label(node: Node, fragment: String) -> bool:
	if node is Label and str((node as Label).text).contains(fragment):
		return true
	for child in node.get_children():
		if _contains_label(child, fragment):
			return true
	return false

func _wall_deadline(simulated_seconds: float) -> int:
	return Time.get_ticks_msec() + ceili(simulated_seconds / maxf(Engine.time_scale, 0.01) * 1000.0)

func _session_is_live() -> bool:
	return is_instance_valid(main) and is_instance_valid(active) and not active.is_queued_for_deletion() and is_instance_valid(main.session) and main.session == active

func _require_live_session(context: String) -> bool:
	if _session_is_live():
		return true
	await _fail("Session disappeared or was replaced while " + context)
	return false

func _require_live_main(context: String) -> bool:
	if is_instance_valid(main) and not main.is_queued_for_deletion() and is_instance_valid(progress):
		return true
	await _fail("Main/Progress disappeared while " + context)
	return false

func _native_click_button(button: BaseButton, context: String) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(button) or not button.is_visible_in_tree() or button.disabled:
		await _fail("Native click target is missing, hidden or disabled: " + context)
		return false
	var ancestor := button.get_parent()
	while ancestor != null:
		if ancestor is ScrollContainer: ancestor.ensure_control_visible(button)
		ancestor = ancestor.get_parent()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(button) or not is_instance_valid(main):
		await _fail("Native click target was released during layout wait: " + context)
		return false
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(button) or not is_instance_valid(main):
		await _fail("Native click target was released during layout wait: " + context)
		return false
	var viewport := button.get_viewport()
	var rect := button.get_global_rect()
	var visible_rect := viewport.get_visible_rect()
	ancestor = button.get_parent()
	while ancestor != null:
		if ancestor is Control and ancestor.clip_contents:
			visible_rect = visible_rect.intersection(ancestor.get_global_rect())
		ancestor = ancestor.get_parent()

func _native_preflight(label: String) -> bool:
	if OS.get_environment("SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH").is_empty() or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":

		get_tree().quit(1)

	progress = get_tree().root.get_node_or_null("Progress")

		push_error("Progress autoload is missing")
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return false
	progress.intro_seen = true
	progress.settings["assist"] = false
	return true

func _start(id: String) -> void:
	observed_result.clear()
	active = GAME_SESSION.new()
	get_tree().root.add_child(active)
	active.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	active.start(id, false)
	active.finished.connect(func(result: Dictionary): observed_result = result.duplicate(true))
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.35).timeout

func _remove() -> void:
	active.queue_free()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().process_frame
	active = null

func _shot(label: String) -> void:
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	var image := get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
	assert(image != null and not image.is_empty())
	var folder := OS.get_environment("SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH").get_base_dir().path_join("captures")
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(folder)
	var path := folder.path_join("%03d-diversity-%s.png" % [_evidence_serial,label])
	_evidence_serial += 1
	assert(not FileAccess.file_exists(path))
	assert(image.save_png(path)==OK)
	print("CAPTURE: "+label+" "+path)

## Dispatch a complete, observable pointer click through the normal input route.
## Both coordinates matter: Input tracks global_position, while Viewport hit-tests
## position. Leaving global_position at zero moves the tracked pointer to (0, 0)
## between events even if gui_get_hovered_control() briefly reports the target.
func _native_click_button(button: BaseButton, context: String) -> bool:
 if not is_instance_valid(button) or not button.is_visible_in_tree() or button.disabled:
  await _fail("Native click target is missing, hidden or disabled: " + context)
  return false
 var ancestor := button.get_parent()
 while ancestor != null:
  if ancestor is ScrollContainer: ancestor.ensure_control_visible(button)
  ancestor = ancestor.get_parent()
 await get_tree().process_frame
 await get_tree().process_frame
 var viewport := button.get_viewport()
 var rect := button.get_global_rect()
 var visible_rect := viewport.get_visible_rect()
 ancestor = button.get_parent()
 while ancestor != null:
  if ancestor is Control and ancestor.clip_contents:
   visible_rect = visible_rect.intersection(ancestor.get_global_rect())
  ancestor = ancestor.get_parent()
 if not visible_rect.encloses(rect):
  await _fail("Native click target is clipped: %s rect=%s visible=%s" % [context, rect, visible_rect])
  return false
 var observation := {"down": 0, "up": 0, "pressed": 0, "gui": []}
 var on_down := func(): observation.down += 1
 var on_up := func(): observation.up += 1
 var on_pressed := func(): observation.pressed += 1
 var on_gui := func(event: InputEvent):
  if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
   observation.gui.append("down" if event.pressed else "up")
 button.button_down.connect(on_down)
 button.button_up.connect(on_up)
 button.pressed.connect(on_pressed)
 button.gui_input.connect(on_gui)
 var target_path := str(button.get_path())
 var point := viewport.get_final_transform() * rect.get_center()
 # Flush queued OS/fixture events before beginning this click. No input state,
 # control signal or gameplay callback is assigned or invoked directly.
 Input.flush_buffered_events()
 var motion := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
 motion.position = point
 motion.global_position = point
 motion.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
 motion.button_mask = Input.get_mouse_button_mask()
 Input.parse_input_event(motion)
 Input.flush_buffered_events()
 var hovered := viewport.gui_get_hovered_control()
 var diagnostics := "target=%s rect=%s pointer=%s hovered=%s button_hovered=%s initial_mask=%d" % [target_path, rect, point, str(hovered.get_path()) if is_instance_valid(hovered) else "none", button.is_hovered(), Input.get_mouse_button_mask()]
 if not button.is_hovered() or not (hovered == button or is_instance_valid(hovered) and button.is_ancestor_of(hovered)):
  for pair in [[button.button_down, on_down], [button.button_up, on_up], [button.pressed, on_pressed], [button.gui_input, on_gui]]:
   pair[0].disconnect(pair[1])
  await _fail("Native pointer did not hover its target: %s; %s" % [context, diagnostics])
  return false
 # Dispatch and flush each distinct event without yielding to unrelated OS
 # motion or deferred focus changes between the observed down and release.
 for is_down in [true, false]:
  var event := InputEventMouseButton.new()
  event.position = point
  event.global_position = point
  event.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
  event.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
  event.button_mask = MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT if is_down else 0
  event.pressed = is_down
  Input.parse_input_event(event)
  Input.flush_buffered_events()
 if is_instance_valid(button):
  for pair in [[button.button_down, on_down], [button.button_up, on_up], [button.pressed, on_pressed], [button.gui_input, on_gui]]:
   pair[0].disconnect(pair[1])
 diagnostics += " observed=%s final_mask=%d" % [observation, Input.get_mouse_button_mask()]
 if observation.down != 1 or observation.pressed != 1:
  await _fail("Native click did not activate its target: %s; %s" % [context, diagnostics])
  return false
 print("INPUT: ", context, " ", diagnostics)
 await get_tree().process_frame
 await get_tree().process_frame
 return true

func _solve_keyboard_order(order_index: int) -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_session("_solve_keyboard_order"): return false
	var route: Array = ORDER_ROUTES[order_index]
	var expected_turn_start: int = active.pipe_model.total_turns
	for cell_variant in route:
		var cell := int(cell_variant)
		if not await _move_keyboard_cursor_to(cell): return false
		if not await _require_live_session("keyboard cursor completion"): return false
		var turns_before: int = active.pipe_model.total_turns
		var mask_before: int = int(active.pipe_model.cells[cell])
		_key(KEY_SPACE)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
		if active.pipe_cursor != cell or active.pipe_model.cursor != cell:
			await _fail("Keyboard selection did not land on tile %d (session/model=%d/%d)" % [cell, active.pipe_cursor, active.pipe_model.cursor])
			return false
		if active.pipe_model.total_turns != turns_before + 1 or int(active.pipe_model.cells[cell]) != _rotate_mask(mask_before):
			await _fail("Space did not make exactly one real rotation at tile %d" % cell)
			return false
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_session("_solve_keyboard_order after frame wait"): return false
	if not active.pipe_model.connected or active.pipe_model.order_index != order_index:
		await _fail("Keyboard route did not truly connect order %d: %s" % [order_index + 1, str(active.pipe_model.snapshot())])
		return false
	if active.pipe_model.order_turns[order_index] != route.size() or active.pipe_model.total_turns != expected_turn_start + route.size():
		await _fail("Keyboard rotations did not match live model order/total counters")
		return false
	await _shot("pipe-controls-keyboard-flow-%d" % (order_index + 1))
	if not _session_is_live() and (order_index != 2 or observed_result.is_empty() or _case_metrics.is_empty()):
		await _fail("Keyboard pipe Session disappeared before its verified final result")
		return false
	return true

func _move_keyboard_cursor_to(cell: int) -> bool:
	if not await _require_live_session("_move_keyboard_cursor_to"): return false
	var target_column := cell % 4
	var target_row := int(cell / 4)
	while active.pipe_cursor % 4 != target_column:
		_key(KEY_RIGHT if active.pipe_cursor % 4 < target_column else KEY_LEFT)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_session("_move_keyboard_cursor_to after wait"): return false
	while int(active.pipe_cursor / 4) != target_row:
		_key(KEY_DOWN if int(active.pipe_cursor / 4) < target_row else KEY_UP)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
		await get_tree().process_frame
		if not await _require_live_session("_move_keyboard_cursor_to after wait"): return false
	if active.pipe_cursor != cell:
		await _fail("Arrow-key navigation expected cell %d, actual cursor %d" % [cell, active.pipe_cursor])
		return false
	return true

	if not await _require_live_session("_solve_pointer_order"): return false
	var route: Array = ORDER_ROUTES[order_index]

	for cell_variant in route:

			return false

		return false

func _native_click_button(button: BaseButton, context: String) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(button) or not button.is_visible_in_tree() or button.disabled:
		await _fail("Native click target is missing, hidden or disabled: " + context)
		return false
	var ancestor := button.get_parent()
	while ancestor != null:
		if ancestor is ScrollContainer: ancestor.ensure_control_visible(button)
		ancestor = ancestor.get_parent()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(button) or not is_instance_valid(main):
		await _fail("Native click target was released during layout wait: " + context)
		return false
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(button) or not is_instance_valid(main):
		await _fail("Native click target was released during layout wait: " + context)
		return false
	var viewport := button.get_viewport()
	var rect := button.get_global_rect()
	var visible_rect := viewport.get_visible_rect()
	ancestor = button.get_parent()
	while ancestor != null:
		if ancestor is Control and ancestor.clip_contents:
			visible_rect = visible_rect.intersection(ancestor.get_global_rect())
		ancestor = ancestor.get_parent()
	if not visible_rect.encloses(rect):
		await _fail("Native click target is clipped: %s rect=%s visible=%s" % [context, rect, visible_rect])
		return false
	var observation := {"down": 0, "up": 0, "pressed": 0, "gui": []}
	var on_down := func(): observation.down += 1
	var on_up := func(): observation.up += 1
	var on_pressed := func(): observation.pressed += 1
	var on_gui := func(event: InputEvent):
		if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
			observation.gui.append("down" if event.pressed else "up")
	button.button_down.connect(on_down)
	button.button_up.connect(on_up)
	button.pressed.connect(on_pressed)
	button.gui_input.connect(on_gui)
	var target_path := str(button.get_path())
	var point := viewport.get_final_transform() * rect.get_center()
	# Flush queued OS/fixture events before beginning this click. No input state,
	# control signal or gameplay callback is assigned or invoked directly.
	Input.flush_buffered_events()
	var motion := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
	motion.position = point
	motion.global_position = point
	motion.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
	motion.button_mask = Input.get_mouse_button_mask()
	Input.parse_input_event(motion)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()
	var hovered := viewport.gui_get_hovered_control()
	var diagnostics := "target=%s rect=%s pointer=%s hovered=%s button_hovered=%s initial_mask=%d" % [target_path, rect, point, str(hovered.get_path()) if is_instance_valid(hovered) else "none", button.is_hovered(), Input.get_mouse_button_mask()]
	if not button.is_hovered() or not (hovered == button or is_instance_valid(hovered) and button.is_ancestor_of(hovered)):
		for pair in [[button.button_down, on_down], [button.button_up, on_up], [button.pressed, on_pressed], [button.gui_input, on_gui]]:
			pair[0].disconnect(pair[1])
		await _fail("Native pointer did not hover its target: %s; %s" % [context, diagnostics])
		return false
	# Dispatch and flush each distinct event without yielding to unrelated OS
	# motion or deferred focus changes between the observed down and release.
	for is_down in [true, false]:
		var event := InputEventMouseButton.new()
		event.position = point
		event.global_position = point
		event.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
		event.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
		event.button_mask = MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT if is_down else 0
		event.pressed = is_down
		Input.parse_input_event(event)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
	if is_instance_valid(button):
		for pair in [[button.button_down, on_down], [button.button_up, on_up], [button.pressed, on_pressed], [button.gui_input, on_gui]]:
			pair[0].disconnect(pair[1])
	diagnostics += " observed=%s final_mask=%d" % [observation, Input.get_mouse_button_mask()]
	if observation.down != 1 or observation.pressed != 1:
		await _fail("Native click did not activate its target: %s; %s" % [context, diagnostics])
		return false
	print("INPUT: ", context, " ", diagnostics)
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(main):
		await _fail("Main was released after native click: " + context)
		return false
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(main):
		await _fail("Main was released after native click: " + context)
		return false
	return true

	get_tree().quit(1)

	var path := folder.path_join("%03d-diversity-%s.png" % [_evidence_serial,label])
	_evidence_serial += 1
	assert(not FileAccess.file_exists(path))
	assert(image.save_png(path)==OK)
	print("CAPTURE: "+label+" "+path)

func _ready() -> void:
	get_tree().auto_accept_quit=false
	capture_mode=OS.get_cmdline_user_args().has("--capture")
	world=WorldScene.new()
	add_child(world)
	audio=Audio.new()
	add_child(audio)
	world.coastal_play.note_requested.connect(audio.play_note)
	story=Story.new()
	definitions=Session.definitions()
	_build_ui()
	world.interaction_requested.connect(_interact)
	world.area_changed.connect(func(name: String):
		area_label.text=name
		_update_breadcrumb(name)
		_sync_audio_environment()
		if session==null: audio.play_context("harbor" if name=="海風碼頭" else "plaza")
	)
	Progress.changed.connect(_refresh)
	Localization.locale_changed.connect(_on_locale_changed)
	Progress.achievement_unlocked.connect(_achievement_toast)
	_refresh()
	audio.play_context("harbor")
	if capture_mode:
		world.player.position=Vector3(0,0.4,9)
		_capture_sequence.call_deferred()
	elif not Progress.intro_seen:
		_show_arrival()
	var user_args := OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
	if user_args.has("--smoke-test"):
		if user_args.has("--smoke-art"):
			_smoke_art_test.call_deferred()
		else:
			_smoke_test.call_deferred()

func _smoke_test() -> void:
	if OS.get_environment("SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH").is_empty():
		push_error("Smoke test requires isolated SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH")
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.5).timeout
	print("PASS: game startup and clean shutdown")
	await _quit_game()

func _smoke_art_test() -> void:
	if DisplayServer.get_name()=="headless":
		await _smoke_art_abort("--smoke-art requires a GPU-backed, non-headless display")
		return
	var review_profile := OS.get_environment("SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH")
	if not review_profile.is_absolute_path():
		await _smoke_art_abort("--smoke-art requires an absolute isolated SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH")
		return
	var review_directory := review_profile.get_base_dir()
	var directory_error := DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(review_directory)
	if directory_error != OK and directory_error != ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS:
		await _smoke_art_abort("Could not prepare the private art review directory")
		return
	var final_status: Dictionary={}
	var final_ready := false
	for game_index in range(1,13):
		var id := "game-%03d"%game_index
		_launch_game(id,false)
		if session==null or session.game_id!=id:
			await _smoke_art_abort("Could not start art smoke game %s"%id)
			return
		# Let the CanvasItem draw the real game frame before checking its shared caches.
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.08).timeout
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
		if not is_instance_valid(session.presentation) or not session.presentation.is_visible_in_tree() or session.presentation_mode != session.mode:
			await _smoke_art_abort("The actual minigame renderer did not become visible: %s"%id)
			return
		var image := get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
		var capture := review_directory.path_join("art-smoke-%s.png"%id)
		if image == null or image.is_empty() or FileAccess.file_exists(capture) or image.save_png(capture) != OK:
			await _smoke_art_abort("Could not preserve a fresh rendered frame for %s"%id)
			return
		print("ART SMOKE DRAW: %s renderer=%s capture=%s"%[id,session.presentation.get_script().resource_path,capture])
		if Session._backdrop_warning_emitted or Session._props_warning_emitted or not world.foliage_warnings.is_empty():
			await _smoke_art_abort("An art resource warning occurred while drawing %s"%id)
			return
		if game_index==12:
			# Bespoke 2D/3D renderers need not draw the old common backdrop.
			# Resolve every shared region separately; do not call it gameplay use.
			if not session.resolve_shared_art_resources():
				await _smoke_art_abort("Shared art resource resolution is incomplete")
				return
			final_status=session.art_cache_status()
			final_ready=session.art_assets_ready()
		_cancel_game()
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	# Explicit resolution above proves unused prop regions load as Texture2D; it
	# does not claim those props were drawn by a game.
	var expected_scenes: Array[String]=Session.BACKDROP_SCENES.duplicate()
	var loaded_scenes: Array=final_status.get("backdrops_loaded",[])
	var missing_scenes: Array=final_status.get("backdrops_missing",[])
	if not final_ready or not bool(final_status.get("backdrop_atlas_loaded",false)) or not missing_scenes.is_empty() or loaded_scenes.size()!=expected_scenes.size():
		await _smoke_art_abort("Backdrop cache incomplete: %s"%str(final_status))
		return
	if not bool(final_status.get("props_atlas_loaded",false)) or not bool(final_status.get("props_regions_loaded",false)) or not final_status.get("props_missing",[]).is_empty() or final_status.get("props_loaded",[]).size()!=Session.REQUIRED_PROP_KEYS.size():
		await _smoke_art_abort("Prop cache incomplete: %s"%str(final_status))
		return
	var foliage_keys: Array[String]=["oak","ginkgo","palm","pine","shrub","planter","rocks","lamp"]
	var actual_foliage_keys: Array[String]=[]
	for key in world.foliage_textures:
		actual_foliage_keys.append(str(key))
		if not world.foliage_textures[key] is Texture2D:
			await _smoke_art_abort("Foliage '%s' is not a Texture2D"%str(key))
			return
	actual_foliage_keys.sort()
	foliage_keys.sort()
	if not world.foliage_atlas_loaded or actual_foliage_keys!=foliage_keys or not world.foliage_warnings.is_empty():
		await _smoke_art_abort("Foliage cache incomplete or warned: %s"%str(actual_foliage_keys))
		return
	if Session._backdrop_warning_emitted or Session._props_warning_emitted:
		await _smoke_art_abort("A minigame art resource warning was emitted during the smoke test")
		return
	var avatar_source=world.avatar_renderer
	if not avatar_source.is_asset_ready() or not avatar_source.has_hat_atlas() or not avatar_source.has_hair_atlas() or not avatar_source.has_species_atlas() or not avatar_source.has_walk_atlas() or not avatar_source.has_diagonal_parts():
		await _smoke_art_abort("Character, hair, hat or species atlas failed to load from the exported resources")
		return
	if world.identity_textures.size()!=3 or not world.identity_warnings.is_empty():
		await _smoke_art_abort("Named character atlas regions failed to load")
		return
	for actor_role in ["ticket", "imp", "announcer"]:
		if world.npc_activity.load_action_frames(actor_role).size() != 4:
			await _smoke_art_abort("Authored NPC activity assets failed to load: " + actor_role)
			return
	var motion_status:Dictionary=world.component_motion.statistics()
	if not bool(motion_status.get("playing",false)) or int(motion_status.get("registration_count",0))<100:
		await _smoke_art_abort("Scene component animation did not start")
		return
	if int(world.occlusion_controller.statistics().get("registered_buildings",0))<15:
		await _smoke_art_abort("Eligible building cutaways were not registered")
		return
	print("PASS: character source assets, three NPC regions, component animation and building cutaway registration")
	print("PASS: art resources loaded (props=%d, scenes=%d, foliage=%d)"%[Session.REQUIRED_PROP_KEYS.size(),loaded_scenes.size(),actual_foliage_keys.size()])
	_cancel_game()
	world.blocked=true
	world.set_process(false)
	audio.shutdown()
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
	get_tree().quit()

func _smoke_art_abort(reason: String) -> void:
	push_error("ART SMOKE FAILED: "+reason)
	if session!=null: _cancel_game()
	world.blocked=true
	world.set_process(false)
	audio.shutdown()
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
	get_tree().quit(1)

func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if what==NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST: _quit_game()

func _quit_game() -> void:
	if quitting: return
	quitting=true
	world.blocked=true
	Progress.save_progress()
	audio.shutdown()

	await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
	get_tree().quit()

func _content_pager(parent: VBoxContainer, node_name: String, entries: Array, render: Callable, capacity: int, navigation_parent: Node = null) -> VBoxContainer:
	var pager := VBoxContainer.new()
	pager.name=node_name
	pager.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	pager.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	pager.add_theme_constant_override("separation",8)
	parent.add_child(pager)
	pager.set_meta("page_entries",entries)
	pager.set_meta("page_renderer",render)
	pager.set_meta("page_capacity",capacity)
	var view := VBoxContainer.new()
	view.name="PageContent"
	view.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	view.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	view.add_theme_constant_override("separation",10)
	if node_name=="TaskPages":
		var viewport := ScrollContainer.new()
		viewport.name="AdaptiveMenuScroll"
		viewport.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		viewport.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		viewport.horizontal_scroll_mode=ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
		viewport.vertical_scroll_mode=ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
		pager.add_child(viewport)
		viewport.add_child(view)
	else:
		pager.add_child(view)
	var navigation := HBoxContainer.new()
	navigation.name=node_name+"Navigation"
	navigation.add_theme_constant_override("separation",8)
	navigation.alignment=BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_END
	(navigation_parent if navigation_parent!=null else pager).add_child(navigation)
	pager.set_meta("page_navigation",navigation)
	var previous := Paper.button("‹",_step_content_page.bind(pager,-1),navigation)
	previous.name=node_name+"Previous"
	previous.tooltip_text="上一頁"
	var counter := Paper.label("",16,Paper.TEAL)
	counter.name="PageCounter"
	counter.autowrap_mode=TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
	counter.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	navigation.add_child(counter)
	var next := Paper.button("›",_step_content_page.bind(pager,1),navigation)
	next.name=node_name+"Next"
	next.tooltip_text="下一頁"
	_render_content_page(pager,0)
	return pager

func _step_content_page(pager: VBoxContainer, amount: int) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(pager): return
	_render_content_page(pager,int(pager.get_meta("page_index",0))+amount)
	var navigation: HBoxContainer=pager.get_meta("page_navigation")
	for control in navigation.get_children():
		if control is Button and not control.disabled:
			control.grab_focus()
			break

func _render_content_page(pager: VBoxContainer, requested: int) -> void:
	var entries: Array=pager.get_meta("page_entries")
	var capacity: int=pager.get_meta("page_capacity")
	var count := maxi(1,ceili(float(entries.size())/capacity))
	var index := clampi(requested,0,count-1)
	pager.set_meta("page_index",index)
	pager.set_meta("page_count",count)
	var view := pager.find_child("PageContent",true,false) as VBoxContainer
	for child in view.get_children():
		view.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	var renderer: Callable=pager.get_meta("page_renderer")
	for item in range(index*capacity,mini((index+1)*capacity,entries.size())):
		renderer.call(view,entries[item],item)
	var navigation: HBoxContainer=pager.get_meta("page_navigation")
	(navigation.get_child(0) as Button).disabled=index==0
	(navigation.get_child(1) as Label).text="%d / %d"%[index+1,count]
	(navigation.get_child(2) as Button).disabled=index==count-1
	navigation.visible=count>1
	call_deferred("_adapt_open_menu")

func _adapt_content_pagers(compact: bool) -> void:
	for node in overlay.find_children("*","VBoxContainer",true,false):
		if not node.has_meta("page_entries"): continue
		var capacity := int(node.get_meta("page_capacity"))
		var desired := capacity
		if node.name=="TaskPages": desired=1 if compact else 2
		elif node.name=="ResultScorePages": desired=1 if compact or Paper.text_scale()>1.1 else 5
		if desired!=capacity:
			var first := int(node.get_meta("page_index",0))*capacity
			node.set_meta("page_capacity",desired)
			_render_content_page(node,floori(float(first)/desired))

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if session!=null and DisplayServer.get_name()!="headless" and session.elapsed>=next_snapshot and not session.ended:
		next_snapshot=session.elapsed+0.9
		_sample_photo.call_deferred()
	if is_instance_valid(world) and modal_kind=="" and session==null:
		var has_context: bool = not world.nearest.is_empty() or world.is_riding()
		context_bar.visible=has_context
		context_action.visible=has_context
		if has_context:
			var prompt := _context_prompt()
			if context_action.text!=prompt:
				context_action.text=prompt
				_adapt_hud()
	if modal_kind=="dialogue" and is_instance_valid(dialogue_label) and dialogue_label.visible_characters>=0:
		var previous_count := dialogue_label.visible_characters
		reveal+=delta*34.0*float(Progress.settings.get("text_speed",1.0))
		var next_count := mini(int(reveal), dialogue_label.text.length())
		dialogue_label.visible_characters=next_count
		for char_index in range(previous_count, next_count):
			var current_speaker := str(dialogue[dialogue_index].get("speaker", "")) if dialogue_index < dialogue.size() else ""
			audio.play_dialogue_beep(current_speaker, dialogue_label.text.substr(char_index, 1))

func _context_prompt() -> String:
	if world.is_riding(): return "E   下來走走"
	var id := str(world.nearest.get("id",""))
	var play_prompt: String=world.coastal_play.prompt(id)
	if world.coastal_play.discoveries.controlling: return play_prompt
	if not play_prompt.is_empty(): return "E   "+play_prompt
	if id.begins_with("game-"): return "E   玩"+str(_definition(id).get("name","這個遊戲"))
	var actor_prompts := {"guide":"和票票說話","quest-001":"和小角說話","quest-002":"和阿浪說話","arrival":"重看上島導覽","ride-tide":"搭乘貝殼輪"}
	return "E   "+str(actor_prompts.get(id,world.nearest.get("label","附近設施")))

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode == KEY_T:
		if modal_kind == "time":
			_close()
		elif modal_kind == "":
			_show_time_panel()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode == KEY_M and modal_kind=="" and session==null:
		_show_ticket()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("pause"):
		if modal_kind=="" and session==null and world.coastal_play.discoveries.end_control(): pass
		elif modal_kind=="dialogue": _cancel_dialogue()
		elif modal_kind!="": _close()
		elif session==null: _show_pause()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	elif event.is_action_pressed("interact"):
		if modal_kind=="dialogue":
			_next_dialogue()
		elif modal_kind=="" and session==null:
			world.interact()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode==KEY_SPACE and modal_kind=="dialogue":
		_next_dialogue()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode==KEY_C:
		if modal_kind=="" and session==null:
			_show_wardrobe()
		elif modal_kind=="wardrobe":
			_close()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func _collect_time_postcard(phase_id: String) -> String:
	if not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, time_capture_token):
		return ""
	var token := time_capture_token
	var saved_paths: Dictionary = await _capture_time_postcard_frame(phase_id, token)
	var frame_path := str(saved_paths.get("thumbnail", ""))
	var original_path := str(saved_paths.get("original", ""))
	if frame_path.is_empty() or not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, token):
		_remove_photo_paths([frame_path, original_path])
		return ""
	if not Progress.collect_time_postcard(phase_id, frame_path, original_path):
		_remove_photo_paths([frame_path, original_path])
		return ""
	return frame_path

func _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id: String, token: int) -> bool:
	return token == time_capture_token and modal_kind == "time" and session == null and is_instance_valid(world) and str(world.nearest.get("id", "")) == "guide" and str(Progress.settings.get("time_phase", "")) == phase_id and TimeOfDay.phase_ids().has(phase_id) and not Progress.photos.has(TimeOfDay.postcard_id(phase_id))

func _capture_time_postcard_frame(phase_id: String, token: int) -> Dictionary:
	if not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, token):
		return {}
	var overlay_was_visible := overlay.visible
	var hud_was_visible := hud.visible
	overlay.hide()
	hud.hide()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, token):
		_restore_time_capture_ui(token, overlay_was_visible, hud_was_visible)
		return {}
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	if not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, token):
		_restore_time_capture_ui(token, overlay_was_visible, hud_was_visible)
		return {}
	var viewport := get_viewport()
	var snapshot := viewport.get_texture().get_image() if is_instance_valid(viewport) else null
	_restore_time_capture_ui(token, overlay_was_visible, hud_was_visible)
	if snapshot == null or snapshot.is_empty() or not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, token):
		return {}
	var original := _prepare_photo_original(snapshot)
	var thumbnail := _prepare_photo_thumbnail(original)
	var directory := _photo_directory()
	var error := DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(directory)
	if error != OK and error != ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS:
		push_warning("Cannot create time postcard directory: " + directory)
		return {}
	var base_path := directory + "/" + TimeOfDay.postcard_id(phase_id)
	var path := base_path + ".png"
	var original_path := base_path + "-original.png"
	if thumbnail.save_png(path) != OK or not _save_bounded_photo_image(original, original_path):
		_remove_photo_paths([path, original_path])
		push_warning("Cannot save time postcard image: " + path)
		return {}
	return {"thumbnail": path, "original": original_path}

func _restore_time_capture_ui(token: int, overlay_visible: bool, hud_visible: bool) -> void:
	if token != time_capture_token or modal_kind != "time":
		return
	overlay.visible = overlay_visible
	hud.visible = hud_visible

func _open_tutorial(target_id: String, origin: String, assisted_mode: bool = false) -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(tutorial_panel):
		return
	tutorial_target=target_id
	tutorial_origin=origin
	tutorial_assist=assisted_mode
	if origin=="session" and session!=null and session.has_method("set_paused"):
		session.set_paused(true)
		world.set_process(false)
	tutorial_panel=TutorialPanelScript.new()
	tutorial_panel.name="TutorialPanel"
	ui.add_child(tutorial_panel)
	tutorial_panel.close_requested.connect(_tutorial_close)
	tutorial_panel.start_requested.connect(_tutorial_start)
	tutorial_panel.skip_requested.connect(_tutorial_skip)
	tutorial_panel.practice_requested.connect(_tutorial_practice)
	_open_tutorial_lesson(target_id)

func _open_tutorial_lesson(target_id: String) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(tutorial_panel):
		return
	var opened: bool = await tutorial_panel.open_tutorial(target_id)
	if not opened:
		_notice("這份教學目前無法開啟，原畫面仍保留。")
		_finish_tutorial_panel()

func _finish_tutorial_panel() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(tutorial_panel):
		tutorial_panel.dismiss()
		tutorial_panel.queue_free()
	tutorial_panel=null

func _tutorial_close() -> void:
	_finish_tutorial_panel()
	if tutorial_origin=="session" and session!=null and session.has_method("set_paused"):
		world.set_process(true)
		# Closing the lesson returns to the paused session HUD; the player chooses when to resume.
		session.set_paused(true)

func _tutorial_skip(_target_id: String) -> void:
	_tutorial_start(tutorial_target)

func _tutorial_start(_target_id: String) -> void:
	var target := tutorial_target
	var origin := tutorial_origin
	var assisted_mode := tutorial_assist
	_finish_tutorial_panel()
	if target=="park":
		if origin=="session" and session!=null:
			world.set_process(true)
			session.set_paused(false)
		return
	if origin=="session" and session!=null:
		world.set_process(true)
		session.set_paused(false)
		return
	if target.begins_with("game-"):
		if origin in ["first_entry", "game_info"] and not Progress.mark_game_tutorial_seen(target):
			_notice("教學已看過，但暫時無法保存；下次仍會教學。")
		_launch_game(target,assisted_mode,false)

func _tutorial_practice(_target_id: String) -> void:
	var target := tutorial_target
	var origin := tutorial_origin
	var assisted_mode := tutorial_assist
	_finish_tutorial_panel()
	if not target.begins_with("game-"):
		if origin=="session" and session!=null:
			world.set_process(true)
			session.set_paused(false)
		return
	if origin=="session" and session!=null:
		if session.has_method("set_practice_mode"):
			world.set_process(true)
			session.set_practice_mode(true)
		return
	_launch_game(target,assisted_mode,true)

func _show_arrival() -> void:
	_start_dialogue(story.intro_lines(),func(): Progress.intro_seen=true; Progress.save_progress(),func(): Progress.intro_seen=true; Progress.save_progress())

func _start_dialogue(lines: Array, done: Callable, cancelled: Callable = Callable()) -> void:
	if lines.is_empty():
		if done.is_valid(): done.call()
		return
	if is_instance_valid(audio):
		audio.set_dialogue_active(true)
	dialogue=lines.duplicate(true)
	dialogue_index=0
	dialogue_done=done
	dialogue_cancelled=cancelled
	if not is_instance_valid(dialogue_panel):
		dialogue_panel=DialoguePanelScript.new()
		dialogue_panel.advance_requested.connect(_next_dialogue)
		dialogue_panel.finished.connect(_cancel_dialogue)
		dialogue_panel.tree_exiting.connect(_dialogue_panel_exiting.bind(dialogue_panel))
		ui.add_child(dialogue_panel)
		dialogue_panel.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		_dialogue_panel_resized()
		if not get_tree().root.size_changed.is_connected(_dialogue_panel_resized):
			get_tree().root.size_changed.connect(_dialogue_panel_resized)
	else:
		dialogue_panel.show()
		dialogue_panel.set_process_unhandled_key_input(true)
	overlay.hide()
	hud.hide()
	world.set_dialogue_hold(true)
	world.blocked=true
	_render_dialogue()

func _render_dialogue() -> void:
	if dialogue_index>=dialogue.size():
		_finish_dialogue()
		return
	var line: Dictionary=dialogue[dialogue_index]
	var speaker := str(line.get("speaker", "旁白"))
	var dialogue_text := str(line.get("text", ""))
	if line.has("text_key"):
		var text_args: Dictionary = line.get("text_args", {})
		dialogue_text=Localization.text(str(line.text_key), text_args)
	dialogue_panel.show_line(speaker,dialogue_text,dialogue_index)
	if line.has("speaker_key"):
		var speaker_args: Dictionary = line.get("speaker_args", {})
		dialogue_panel.speaker_label.text=Localization.text(str(line.speaker_key), speaker_args)
	dialogue_label=dialogue_panel.text_label
	call_deferred("_dialogue_panel_resized")
	reveal=0
	modal_kind="dialogue"

func _next_dialogue() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(dialogue_label): return
	if dialogue_label.visible_characters>=0 and dialogue_label.visible_characters<dialogue_label.text.length():
		reveal=dialogue_label.text.length()
		dialogue_panel.reveal_all()
	else:
		dialogue_index+=1
		_render_dialogue()

func _finish_dialogue(cancelled: bool = false) -> void:
	var callback := dialogue_done
	var cancel_callback := dialogue_cancelled
	dialogue_done=Callable()
	dialogue_cancelled=Callable()
	if is_instance_valid(dialogue_panel):
		dialogue_panel.set_process_unhandled_key_input(false)
		dialogue_panel.hide()
		dialogue_panel.queue_free()
	dialogue_panel=null
	dialogue_label=null
	dialogue.clear()
	if is_instance_valid(audio):
		audio.set_dialogue_active(false)
	overlay.hide()
	modal_kind=""
	if is_instance_valid(world):
		world.set_dialogue_hold(false)
		world.blocked=session!=null
	if is_instance_valid(hud): hud.show()
	if cancelled:
		if cancel_callback.is_valid(): cancel_callback.call()
	elif callback.is_valid():
		callback.call()

func _cancel_dialogue() -> void:
	_finish_dialogue(true)

func _dialogue_panel_exiting(panel: Control) -> void:
	if dialogue_panel!=panel: return
	if is_instance_valid(audio):
		audio.set_dialogue_active(false)
	dialogue_panel=null
	dialogue_label=null
	dialogue_done=Callable()
	dialogue_cancelled=Callable()
	dialogue.clear()
	if modal_kind=="dialogue":
		modal_kind=""
		if is_instance_valid(world):
			world.set_dialogue_hold(false)
			world.blocked=session!=null

func _dialogue_panel_resized() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(dialogue_panel): return
	var scale_factor := Paper.physical_scale(dialogue_panel)
	Paper.adapt_menu(dialogue_panel, scale_factor)
	if is_instance_valid(dialogue_label): dialogue_label.custom_minimum_size.y=82.0/scale_factor
	var plaque := dialogue_panel.find_child("DialoguePlaque", true, false) as Control
	var height := 210.0/scale_factor
	if plaque != null:
		plaque.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x-48.0/scale_factor,0)
		height=maxf(height,plaque.get_combined_minimum_size().y)
		plaque.custom_minimum_size.y=height
	var center := dialogue_panel.get_child(0) as CenterContainer
	center.anchor_top=1.0
	center.anchor_bottom=1.0
	center.offset_left=24.0/scale_factor
	center.offset_right=-24.0/scale_factor
	center.offset_top=-height-20.0/scale_factor
	center.offset_bottom=-20.0/scale_factor

func _interact(id: String, title: String) -> void:
	audio.play_sfx("interact")
	if world.coastal_play.activate(id):
		return
	if id.begins_with("game-"):
		_show_game_info(id)
	elif id=="arrival":
		_start_dialogue(story.intro_lines(),func(): Progress.intro_seen=true; Progress.save_progress(),func(): Progress.intro_seen=true; Progress.save_progress())
	elif id=="guide":
		_start_dialogue(story.main_lines(),func(): Progress.grant_photo("photo-welcome-story-1"); _notice("第一張主線拍貼，收進本子裡了。"))
	elif id=="quest-001" or id=="quest-002":
		var actor_lines := _actor_dialogue_lines(id)
		_start_dialogue(actor_lines,func():
			_record_story_mission_event({"type":"interaction","id":id})
			_show_quest(id)
		,func(): _record_story_mission_event({"type":"interaction","id":id}))
	elif id=="ride-tide":
		if world.is_riding():
			world.end_ride()
		else:
			world.start_ride()
	elif id=="album": _show_album()
	elif id=="settings": _show_settings()
	elif id=="clock":
		world.set_night(not world.night)
		_notice("夜晚亮起來了。" if world.night else "陽光回到島上了。")
	elif id.begins_with("coast:"):
		var discovery: Dictionary = world.coast_description(id)
		if not discovery.is_empty():
			_start_dialogue([{ "speaker":str(discovery.name), "text":str(discovery.text) }],Callable())
	elif id.begins_with("explore-"): _show_exploration(id)
	elif id=="rift":
		var body := _open(title,"LITTLE DEVILS","rift")
		body.add_child(Paper.label("集齊迎賓大道十二張小惡魔拍貼，倒影大道的門就會記住你。\n目前 %d / 12。"%Progress.devil_count(),24))
		body.add_child(Paper.label("倒影大道正在準備新的布景；本版保留入口。",22))
		_back(body)
	elif id.begins_with("gate:"):
		var data: Dictionary=world.park_data()
		for zone in data.zones:
			if zone.id==id.trim_prefix("gate:"):
				var body := _open(zone.name,"NEXT ADVENTURE","gate")
				body.add_child(Paper.label(zone.theme,25))
				body.add_child(Paper.label("入園資格：%d 張不同普通拍貼（不消耗）\n目前：%d 張\n\n這座園區正在準備中。先去迎賓大道留下今天的回憶吧。"%[zone.threshold,Progress.normal_count()],22))
				_back(body)
				break

func _actor_dialogue_lines(quest_id: String) -> Array:
	var mission: Dictionary=story.quest_data(quest_id).get("mission",{})
	var speaker := str(mission.get("speaker", ""))
	var lines: Array=[]
	for line: Dictionary in story.main_lines():
		if str(line.get("speaker", "")) == speaker:
			lines.append(line)
	return lines

func _definition(id: String) -> Dictionary:
	for definition in definitions:
		if definition.get("id","")==id: return definition
	return {}

		child.queue_free()
